preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 20,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 10**5 for n, S, edges in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of vertices n is between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= S <= 10**16 for n, S, edges in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the maximum possible sum of weights S is between 1 and 10^16 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == n - 1 for n, S, edges in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each test case has exactly n-1 edges.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v_i <= n and 1 <= u_i <= n for n, S, edges in test_cases for v_i, u_i, w_i, c_i in edges)
preconditions.description: For each edge in a test case, vertices v_i and u_i are between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= w_i <= 10**6 for n, S, edges in test_cases for v_i, u_i, w_i, c_i in edges)
preconditions.description: For each edge in a test case, the weight w_i is between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= c_i <= 2 for n, S, edges in test_cases for v_i, u_i, w_i, c_i in edges)
preconditions.description: For each edge in a test case, the cost c_i is either 1 or 2.

preconditions.expression: sum(n for n, S, edges in test_cases) <= 10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of n across all test cases does not exceed 100,000.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines is equal to the number of test cases t.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(cost, int) and cost >= 0 for cost in output)
postconditions.description: Each output cost is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(path_weight(root, leaf) for leaf in leaves) <= S for (n, S, edges), cost in zip(test_cases, output))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the sum of weights of paths from the root to each leaf is at most S after the minimum cost operations.
